paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates BLEU score as a function of latency, showing four system variants on the IWSLT14 De dataset. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and uses a linear scale, spanning roughly from 1 to 9 with major tick labels at 2, 4, 6, and 8. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 19 to 33 with labeled ticks every 2 units (20, 22, …, 32). The “Consistency-CE” series is drawn as a light purple dashed line with circular markers, increasing from about 19.2 BLEU at AL≈1.0 to about 31.3 at AL≈8.5, with intermediate points near 26.2 (AL≈3.2), 28.7 (AL≈5.2), and 30.4 (AL≈7.0). The “Inconsistency-CE” series is a darker purple dashed line with square markers, rising from about 22.8 at AL≈1.5 to about 31.6 at AL≈8.5, passing through approximately 27.0 (AL≈3.2), 29.6 (AL≈5.2), and 30.8 (AL≈7.0). The “Inconsistency-CE-MP” series is a blue dashed line with square markers, increasing from roughly 22.4 at AL≈2.2 to about 31.8 at AL≈8.5, with points around 27.0 (AL≈3.6), 29.6 (AL≈5.2), and 31.0 (AL≈7.0). The “Consistency-Bi” series is a red solid line with star markers, rising from about 25.9 at AL≈1.5 to about 32.3 at AL≈8.6, with intermediate values near 28.7 (AL≈3.3), 30.9 (AL≈5.0), and 32.0 (AL≈7.0).
